scope: Official documentation/schema/release metadata only; no road-data file or tool downloaded.

facts: Transportation is a global segment/connector dataset with OSM and additional sources.
Published examples allow bbox and property filtering of cloud GeoParquet.
US examples are illustrative, not evidence that required timing fields cover every US road.
Roads can carry speed_limits, access_restrictions and prohibited_transitions.
Rules may be direction/time/mode/vehicle scoped or apply to subranges.
Implied speed limits are not populated by the schema; absent explicit data must remain unknown.
Schema includes geometry, sources, connectors, level_rules and scoped speed_limits with explicit units.
These are schema capabilities, not observed coverage or speed measurements in our pilot.
Road queries can select segments whose bboxes intersect the target bbox, including crossing features.
SQL row limits or output size do not establish a network-transfer limit; our proposed byte meter is separate.
Documentation reports release 2026-10-21.0 and schema v2.0.0 on the inspection date.
Public releases have limited retention; the proposed reader must verify and freeze actual manifests/object identities before any data request, and stop if the pinned release is unavailable.
Transportation is published under ODbL and credits OpenStreetMap contributors and TomTom.
Attribution/source-license metadata must be retained in any later derivative; no new derivative is published by this proposal.
maxspeed denotes a legal speed limit, with units, rather than measured average journey speed.
